Looking at the dparse library, a requirement object has:
- `name`: package name
- `specs`: list of (operator, version) tuples for version specifiers
- `extras`: optional extras

The specification string should be in the format: `package_name[extras]operator1version1,operator2version2,...`

def parse_requirement(dep: str, found: Optional[str]) ->PythonSpecification:
    specs_str = ""

        specs_str = "".join([f"{op}{ver}" for op, ver in dep.specs])

        extras_str = f"[{','.join(dep.extras)}]"
    
    spec_string = f"{dep.name}{extras_str}{specs_str}" if specs_str else f"{dep.name}{extras_str}"
    
    return PythonSpecification(spec_string, found=found)
